subject: The 2AM feature I built for you
preview_text: I wasn't going to share this yet, but you need to see what it caught in your last conversation.
body_paragraphs: Two nights ago, I was sitting alone at my desk, staring at a conversation screenshot a user sent me. It was a text exchange that looked totally normal on the surface, but something felt off. I built a new tool on a whim, just to test a hunch, and what it found made me sick. I wasn't planning to release this until next month, but I can't keep it from you any longer.

You know that gut feeling you get when something isn't right, but you can't quite put your finger on it? That's exactly what this tool is designed for. It's a hidden pattern scanner that digs into your chat history and surfaces the subtle red flags your brain tries to ignore. I ran it on my own old messages, and it showed me things I missed for months. I owe it to you to let you use it now.

Open the app, and you'll see a new tab labeled 'Hidden Patterns.' Tap it, then scan any conversation you've been second-guessing. The AI will highlight manipulation tactics, like gaslighting or love bombing, that you might have overlooked. It's like having a detective in your pocket, one that's brutally honest and always on your side.

Go open Red Flag Scanner AI and check the 'Hidden Patterns' tab. Run it on a chat that's been weighing on you. See what surfaces. P.S. I've only shared this with 50 users so far, and the results have been jaw-dropping. Don't tell your friends about it yet. This one's just for you.
